sloka: तां प्रतिज्ञां प्रतिज्ञाय पुरा सत्यपराक्रम ।लघुः कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो नैवं वक्तुमिहार्हसि ।। ६.१०२.४२ ।।
transliteration: tāṁ pratijñāṁ pratijñāya purā satyaparākrama ।laghuḥ kaścidivāsattvo naivaṁ vaktumihārhasi ।। 6.102.42 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Lakshmana rise up from the surface of the ground, the Vanaras said Well done and offered prayers very affectionately.
